title: Pacifying a hostile creature with 'name it' (barrow-wight, honour guard) sets it to 'stood down' but the blocked passage still requires a second explicit interaction (attack/slip past/rite) to actually open — the stand-down message implies the path is clear when it isn't.
where: Barrow Crypt (Vale) and The Old Crypts (Marrowgate)
